title: ToolExecutionRequest
description: POST /v1/tools/{tool} on security-gateway (via BFF /api/v1/security/tools/{tool}). Non-read tiers require approval_id from /approve for this exact request.

network_profile.description: Network access level. lab/public require SECURITY_EGRESS_NETWORK and matching ALLOW_*_TARGETS flags.

destinations.description: Hostnames or public IPs the sandbox may reach. Required when network_profile is not offline. Private/reserved addresses, wildcards, and local TLDs are rejected.
